title: Historic Harbor Tours and Dolphin Watch
specs: Close-up encounters with big ships, dolphins, and seabirds
Views of historic sites including the restored 1877 sailing vessel Elissa and Civil War Battle of Galveston sites
Boat can be booked for private events such as birthday parties, office get-togethers, receptions, and conventions
includes: U.S. Coast Guard certified vessel and licensed operators
Sheltered main deck and open upper deck for panoramic views
blurb: Guests experience Galveston Harbor on a 50-foot twin-engine motor vessel with views of historic sites, wildlife, and dolphins. The boat is U.S. Coast Guard certified and has a sheltered main deck and open upper deck. Tours include history, wildlife, and folklore of Galveston Bay.
extraNote: No operation during lightning, thunderstorms, sustained winds of 25 knots or higher, or Small Craft Advisory · Tours may be postponed or canceled due to visibility less than 1/2 nautical mile or other safety concerns · No operation on Nov 3-6, Christmas Eve, Christmas Day, New Year's Day; early close at 3 p.m. on New Year's Eve · Galveston Historic Seaport
